 Dear Seller,
We noticed that you are currently missing active offers in the Netherlands store . Adding offers on Amazon.nl is essential for the Pan European FBA (Pan EU) program, both to maintain your current enrollment and to add more products to Pan EU .

 Que se passe-t-il si je ne prends pas ces mesures ?

 Vous devez prélever ces produits de nos centres de distribution dans les 30 jours suivant cette notification. Découvrez comment prélever du stock sur la page d’aide Prélever du stock .
 Nous sommes là pour vous aider.

 CSBA Insights Dashboard
 Get the most out of Customer Service by Amazon
 Use the CSBA Insights dashboard in Seller Central to:
- Review customer service contacts handled by Amazon
- Find ways to improve customer experience
- Reduce contact and return rates
 Follow these practices to prevent customer confusion and minimize your workload:
- Monitor the Response Needed inbox within the Buyer-Seller Messaging Service . In the rare case that we need your help to resolve a customer issue, we'll summarize the conversation and pass the contact to you. You're expected to answer within 24 hours to ensure a great customer experience. You’ll still be responsible for pre-order inquiries.
- Avoid initiating 1:1 contact with customers. If you reach out to customers directly, Amazon can no longer support the customer regarding that order and you'll have to take responsibility for the rest of the conversation.
- Provide valid tracking. Include a valid tracking number with every shipment. This is the best way to prevent customers from contacting customer service. Plus, maintaining less than a 95% VTR is part of the eligibility criteria for free CSBA coverage.
- Improve product descriptions based on refunds. More accurate product descriptions can help manage customer expectations.
- Was a customer issued a refund incorrectly? If Amazon issues a refund and you don't think that you should be held financially responsible, do not contact the customer. Instead, file a claim for reimbursement via Seller Assurance for E-Commerce Transactions (SAFE-T). Learn more about SAFE-T claim eligibility and filing processes .

 How are CSBA fees calculated and applied?

 Customer Service by Amazon fees .
- CSBA fees are not applied to any FBA, Easy Ship, or seller-fulfilled Prime units
- CPU rate is only calculated based on post-order contacts that Amazon handles on your behalf
- In rare instances, the contact count used for fee calculations may be lower than the total count shown on your dashboard. The difference in contacts counts does not impact your fees.

body_preview:
96
 We’ll refund digital services fees and the taxes on those fees related to the Canadian digital services tax that we had charged from September 1, 2024, through August 15, 2025.
 Hello,
 On August 15, 2025, we stopped collecting digital service fees after the Canadian government announced its intention to repeal the Digital Services Tax Act. The Canadian government repealed the Digital Services Tax Act on March 26, 2026.
 As a result, we’ll refund digital services fees and the taxes on those fees related to the Canadian digital services tax that we had charged from September 1, 2024 through August 15, 2025. We’ll begin processing the refunds on April 15, 2026, and we’ll complete them by May 15, 2026. No action is required from you.
 To view your refunds, which will include the digital service fees and the taxes on those fees, follow these steps:
- Go to the Payments dashboard .
- Click Transaction View .
- Under Transaction type , select Other .
- Set the date range from April 15 2026, to May 15 2026, and click Update .
- Download the file and open it in Excel.
- Filter the Product details column with Digital services fee adjustment and Taxes on digital services fee adjustment .

- The credit amount will be displayed in the Total column. To review the total amount of digital services fees that you paid from September 1, 2024, through August 15, 2025, follow these steps:

- Under Simplified report configuration options , select the Fee data checkbox and click Generate report .
- Open the CSV file. In the file, search for Digital services fee (Selling on Amazon fees) total column header and sum the total. For more information about the digital services fee and how it’s applied, go to Digital services fee .

body_preview:
Hello from Amazon Selling Partner Support,
My name is Ritam. I am a Live Channel Specialist and I'm contacting you to follow up on your concern regarding the reinstatement of your listing B0FCDRNTT8.
Upon checking, I would like to inform you that your listing B0FCDRNTT8 comes under 2 separate policy violations - 'Food and Product Safety Issues' and 'Regulatory Compliance'.
You submission to address the Regulatory Compliance was rejected. This request applies to you if you are fulfilling your chemical products via the Amazon Fulfillment Network (AFN) and this compliance request is for a Safety Data Sheet (SDS). If you are using another method of fulfillment, such as the Merchant Fulfillment Network (MFN), please disregard this request.

subject: RE:[CASE 11569978862] 【需立即行动】请通过亚马逊认可的TIC服务商完成儿童玩具合规
body_preview:
尊敬的卖家：
我们紧急通知您，您在【欧洲】站点的部分【儿童玩具】商品尚未完成合规，即将面临下架风险。为避免下架，请在截止日期之前完成以下操作，并确保TRF状态更新为【正在验证】或【已通过】。
【如何完成合规?】
您必须与第三方检测、检验和认证服务提供商合作，对收到通知的所有 ASIN 进行商品检测或验证现有的检测文件。请按照以下步骤操作：
1.前往【绩效】-【账户状况】-【政策合规性】，点击【食品和商品安全问题】。
2.在【后续步骤】列下，针对需操作的商品点击【提交】-【验证您的商品】。
3.从清单中选择第三方检测提供商（如需比价，可先查看【从多个提供商获取报价的说明】后再返回选择），点击继续。
4.确认详细联系信息，点击【确认并继续】。
5.复制生成的检测申请表编号，提供给所选提供商完成检测
如果验证现有文件，您必须将由 ISO 17025 认可的实验室出具的检测报告提交至检测、检验和认证服务提供商。
如何查看TRF状态：在绩效 > 账户状况 > 食品和商品安全问题找到ASIN，点击右方“提交，查看或更新” > “验证您的商品”
⚠️请注意：
① 同一ASIN可能只在部分欧洲站点被触发通知，若您计划在欧洲（英国及欧盟）继续销售，只需为每个ASIN任选一个站点完成合规，测试结果将同步至全欧站点。
② 由于数据可能存在延迟，请务必以卖家平台【绩效 > 账户状况 > 食品和商品安全问题】页面显示的最新状态为准。再次提醒您，为避免下架，请在截止日期之前确保TRF状态更新为【正在验证】或【已通过】。
③ 如果您认为您的产品不属于【儿童玩具】产品，请选择【申诉请求】选项，提供您认为产品被错误识别的原因进行申诉。
感谢您的支持，祝您合规大卖！
如有疑问，请扫码加入亚马逊卖家合规群：
https://m.media-amazon.com/images/G/01/CN_Compliance_Team/mass_wecom_yt.jpg
Amazon Global Selling Seller Compliance Team

body_full:
96
 Submit product safety documentation to reactivate listings
 Hello Weihai US,
 Some of your listings have been deactivated due to missing mandatory compliance requirements for your products. Review the details and next steps below. The affected listings are shown at the end of this email.
 Why is this happening?
 We are taking this action because these products are missing mandatory compliance information. Review our Product safety and compliance help page for information on applicable laws, regulations, and Amazon policies. We leveraged a combination of automated means and expert human review to identify this issue and make this decision.
 The table at the end of this email provides product-specific compliance requirements.
 How do I reactivate my listings?
 To provide the required compliance information, go to your Account Health page and locate the product compliance requests:
-
 If you have the required documentation, follow the instructions to submit your compliance documents. We will only reinstate products that fulfill the compliance requirements.
-
 If you believe your products are exempt from these requirements, submit documentation demonstrating why they are not subject to these compliance requirements.
 For step-by-step instructions, see our Submit compliance documents or appeal a documentation request help page.
 To avoid further impact to your account, close or delete any non-compliant listings that you do not intend to sell or appeal.
 What happens if I don't take these actions?

96
 Reactivate your EU listings - GPSR compliance required
 Hello Weihai EU,
 Some of your listings have been deactivated from our European Union (EU) stores due to missing compliance information. This action does not impact your account health.
 You can find examples of your deactivated listings at the bottom of this email, and the full list on your Account Health page. Review the affected listings and next steps to meet General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) requirements below.
 Submit compliance information
 Submit compliance information
 How do I reactivate my listings?
 To reactivate your listings, provide the required GPSR compliance information by following the instructions below:
-
 Go to your Account Health page .
- Select 'Add filters' and check 'Listing removed' in the "Filter by action taken" column.
- Click 'Submit' next to the deactivated listing and follow the instructions provided.
- Follow the steps on Suppressed listings to resolve any outstanding listing issues. Existing issues prevent listings from being reactivated, even if you’ve fulfilled all compliance requirements.
 Note: If you’ve recently submitted information on your Account Health page, and no longer have pending actions in the Open Tab in the Regulatory compliance section, you can disregard this message.
 Why is this happening?
 We took this decision because some of your products have been identified as missing required compliance information. The GPSR, effective December 13, 2024, introduces requirements for most non-food consumer products offered for sale in the EU . The three requirements are:
- Responsible Person information: Appoint an EU-established Responsible Person for your non-food products, update the labeling for your products, and display the information on your listings.
- Manufacturer information: Display the contact information for the manufacturer on your listings for non-food products and update the labeling for your products accordingly.
- Warning and safety information: Ensure your non-food products meet all labeling and traceability requirements, and update your listings accordingly.
 For detailed requirements, refer to the “ General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) ” help page.
 We leveraged a combination of automated means and expert human review to identify this issue and make this decision.
 What happens if I don't submit the required information?
 If you don't provide the compliance information for your products, your deactivated listings will remain non-sellable until the required information is provided. If you use Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), you may not be able to replenish the inventory in our fulfilment centers and your inventory will be returned or disposed. If you don’t provide the information within 30 days of receiving this email, it will be destroyed at your cost. Any return requirements will be communicated separately.
 What if I don't want to continue selling impacted products?
 If you don't want to continue selling impacted products on Amazon’s EU stores, you can delete them via the “Manage Inventory” dashboard. For more information, see “Manage inventory” help page . You will then need to wait for the inventory to be returned to you or disposed, or remove it yourself. To remove your inventory, you can follow the steps on the “Remove inventory from a fulfilment center” help page to create a removal order.
 Have your listings been removed in error?
 If you believe your listings have been deactivated in error and are not subject to the GPSR, contact Selling Partner Support . You must provide an explanation of the issue, the brand name, and a list of ASINs in an Excel file.
 We're here to help.
 To learn more, go to “General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR)” help page .
 If you have questions about this policy, contact Selling Partner Support .

VAT Calculation Services will calculate VAT by shipment as of June
 1
body_preview:
96
 New tax calculation method ensures compliance with European e-invoicing mandates.
 Hello,
 Effective as of June 1, 2026, we’re updating Value Added Tax (VAT) Calculation Services (VCS) to comply with European e-invoicing mandates. Instead of calculating VAT per unit, VCS will calculate VAT on the total invoice amount by tax rate. This means when customers buy multiple units, the total invoice amounts may differ from current calculations.
 Depending on the sales channel (regardless of customer VAT registration), VCS will apply one of two methods:
- Consumer website : VCS will impute VAT from the VAT-inclusive price. If multiple units are purchased, unit exclusive prices may vary.
- Amazon Business website : VCS will derive the VAT-exclusive unit price from the VAT-inclusive unit price. VAT will be calculated on the total VAT-exclusive price by tax rate. For more information about invoice-total VAT calculations and to view examples, go to section 10: Invoice-total VAT calculation method of VAT Calculation Services methodology .
 The Amazon Europe team

 Hej Weihai EU!
 Vissa av dina produktposter riskerar att inaktiveras på grund av att det saknas obligatorisk information om överensstämmelse för produkterna. Granska informationen och följande steg nedan. De berörda produktposterna visas i slutet av det här e-postmeddelandet.
 Varför händer det här?
 Vi vidtar den här åtgärden eftersom det saknas obligatorisk information om överensstämmelse för de här produkterna. Läs vår hjälpsida för Produktsäkerhet och -överensstämmelse för information om tillämpliga lagar, förordningar och Amazons policyer.
 Tabellen i slutet av detta e-postmeddelande innehåller produktspecifika krav för överensstämmelse.
 Hur återaktiverar jag mina produktposter?
 Om du vill tillhandahålla den begärda överensstämmelseinformationen går du till sidan Kontostatus och letar upp begäranden om produktöverensstämmelse:
-
 Om du har den obligatoriska dokumentationen ska du skicka in dina överensstämmelsedokument enligt instruktionerna.
-
 Om du tror att dina produkter är undantagna från dessa krav skickar du in dokumentation som visar varför de inte omfattas av dessa överensstämmelsekrav.
 Du hittar stegvisa instruktioner på vår hjälpsida om Skicka in intyg om öve

 Hello Weihai US,
 Under the US INFORM Consumers Act, you are required to keep certain business information provided to Amazon current, including your name, address, phone number, email address, bank account information, and Tax ID number. You are also required to electronically certify to Amazon at least once per year that either you have provided any changes to your information or there have been no changes to this information.
 Review your account information and complete your electronic certification by following the instructions below to avoid disruption to your selling account. If you do not certify your information within 10 days of this notice, your account will be at risk of account deactivation, as required by the law.
 (Please disregard this notice if you have already certified your information and received an acknowledgment notice.)
 How do I certify my information and avoid account deactivation?
 Go to the INFORM Act Notice and Certification step in your ( Account Health page ).
 Follow the instructions on the page to review the required information, update it if necessary, and click the “Certify” button to certify that it is up-to-date.
 Please note that only the primary user or secondary user authorized with Confirm/Change Account Information permissions will be able to certify the information.
 What happens if I don’t complete certification within 10 days?
 If you do not certify your information within 10 days of this notice, you will receive account deactivation warning notifications, and your account will be at risk of deactivation as required by the law.
 We're here to help.
 To learn more, refer to our 'About the INFORM Consumers Act' ( help page ).

 Hemos tomado esta decisión porque hemos identificado que a algunos de tus productos les falta información de cumplimiento normativo obligatoria. El Reglamento relativo a la seguridad general de los productos, con entrada en vigor el 13 de diciembre de 2024, introduce los requisitos para la mayoría de los productos de consumo no alimentarios que se pongan a la venta en la UE . Estos tres requisitos son los siguientes:
- Información de la persona responsable: designa a una persona responsable establecida en la UE para tus productos no alimenticios, actualiza el etiquetado de los productos y muestra la información en los listings.
- Información del fabricante: muestra la información de contacto del fabricante en los listings de productos no alimenticios y actualiza el etiquetado de los productos según corresponda.
- Advertencias e información de seguridad: asegúrate de que tus productos no alimenticios cumplan todos los requisitos de etiquetado y trazabilidad y actualiza los listings según corresponda.
 Para más información y detalles, consulta Reglamento relativo a la seguridad general de los productos .
 Hemos usado una combinación de medios automatizados y revisión humana experta para identificar la incidencia y tomar esta decisión.
 ¿Qué ocurre si no envío la información obligatoria?
 Si no proporcionas la información de cumplimiento normativo de tus productos, los listings desactivados permanecerán como no aptos para la venta hasta que proporciones la información obligatoria. Si utilizas Logística de Amazon, es posible que no puedas reabastecer el inventario en nuestros centros logísticos y se te devolverá o se pondrá a disposición de Amazon. Si no proporcionas la información en un plazo de 30 días a partir de la recepción de este correo electrónico, lo eliminaremos con coste a tu cargo. Los requisitos de devolución de inventario se comunicarán por separado.
 ¿Qué ocurre si no quiero seguir vendiendo productos afectados?
 Si no quieres seguir vendiendo los productos afectados en nuestras tiendas de la UE, puedes eliminarlos a través del panel de control de "Gestión de inventario". Para más información, consulta Gestión de inventario . A continuación, tendrás que esperar a que te devolvamos el inventario o que lo pongamos a nuestra disposición, o puedes retirarlo por tu cuenta. Para retirar el inventario, sigue los pasos que se indican en Retirada de inventario de un centro logístico para crear una solicitud de retirada de inventario.
 ¿Hemos retirado tus listings por error?
 Si crees que tus listings se han desactivado por error y no están sujetos al Reglamento relativo a la seguridad general de los productos, contacta con Atención al colaborador comercial . Tienes que proporcionar una explicación de la situación, nombre de la marca y una lista de ASIN en un archivo de Excel.

 Starting April 9, 2026, you can store your inventory in bulk at a lower cost in our new Global Warehousing & Distribution (GWD) facility in Shenzhen, China, and seamlessly replenish to our US fulfillment network when needed.
 By using GWD in Shenzhen, you can:
- Reduce storage costs by up to 45% compared to US Amazon Warehousing and Distribution (AWD).
- Get inventory to US fulfillment centers up to seven days faster when paired with Amazon Global Logistics (AGL).
- Maintain consistently healthy inventory levels through reliable, automated cross-border replenishment.
- Choose your management style of either AI-powered automated replenishment or manual control while we handle the entire cross-border logistics process.
- Streamline your supply chain of shipping, customs clearance, and delivery to our fulfillment centers all through a single, integrated solution. GWD is the first step in our Next Generation of Global Selling vision — where you list once, bring your inventory to the warehouse at origin, and sell it globally from day one. This vision transforms cross-border commerce: you focus on building your global brand while Amazon handles the operational complexity of reaching customers worldwide.

 Come faccio a riattivare le mie offerte?
 Per riattivare le offerte, fornisci le informazioni richieste relative alla conformità al regolamento sulla sicurezza generale dei prodotti seguendo le istruzioni riportate di seguito:
-
 Vai alla pagina Stato dell'account .
- Seleziona "Aggiungi filtri" e quindi "Offerta rimossa" nella colonna "Filtra per azione intrapresa".
- Clicca su "Invia" accanto all'offerta disattivata e segui le istruzioni fornite.
- Segui la procedura indicata nella pagina Offerte rimosse per risolvere eventuali problemi relativi alle offerte in sospeso. I problemi esistenti impediscono di riattivare le offerte, anche se hai soddisfatto tutti i requisiti di conformità.
 Nota: se di recente hai inviato informazioni nella pagina Stato dell'account e non hai più azioni in sospeso nella scheda Apri della sezione Conformità normativa, puoi ignorare questo messaggio.
 Ciò a cosa è dovuto?
 Abbiamo preso questa decisione perché in alcuni dei tuoi prodotti mancano le informazioni sulla conformità obbligatorie. Il regolamento sulla sicurezza generale dei prodotti, che entrerà in vigore il 13 dicembre 2024, introdurrà requisiti concernenti la maggior parte dei prodotti di consumo non alimentari venduti nell'Unione europea . I tre requisiti sono i seguenti:
- Dati della persona responsabile: nomina una persona responsabile con sede nell'Unione europea per i tuoi prodotti non alimentari, aggiorna l'etichettatura dei tuoi prodotti e mostra le informazioni sulle tue offerte.
- Informazioni sul produttore: mostra i recapiti del produttore sulle tue offerte per i prodotti non alimentari e aggiorna di conseguenza l'etichettatura dei prodotti.
- Informazioni di sicurezza e avvertenze: assicurati che i tuoi prodotti non alimentari soddisfino tutti i requisiti di etichettatura e tracciabilità e aggiorna le tue offerte di conseguenza.
 Per i requisiti dettagliati, consulta la pagina di aiuto " Regolamento sulla sicurezza generale dei prodotti ".
 Questa decisione è stata presa sulla base dei risultati di un'analisi effettuata in parte tramite revisione umana e in parte per mezzo di sistemi automatizzati.
 Cosa succede se non invio le informazioni richieste?
 Se non fornisci le informazioni di conformità per i tuoi prodotti, le offerte disattivate rimarranno non vendibili fino a quando non saranno fornite le informazioni richieste. Se utilizzi Logistica di Amazon (FBA), potresti non essere in grado di rifornire l'inventario nei nostri centri logistici, che verrà restituito o reimpiegato. Se non fornisci tali informazioni entro 30 giorni dalla ricezione di questa e-mail, verrà distrutto a tue spese. Eventuali requisiti di restituzione verranno comunicati separatamente.
 Cosa succede se non desidero continuare a vendere i prodotti interessati?
 Se non desideri continuare a vendere i prodotti interessati nei negozi Amazon dell'Unione europea, puoi eliminarli tramite la dashboard Gestisci il tuo inventario. Per maggiori informazioni, consulta la pagina di aiuto Gestisci il tuo inventario. Dovrai quindi attendere la restituzione o il reimpiego dell'inventario, oppure rimuoverlo personalmente. Per rimuovere l'inventario, puoi seguire la procedura riportata nella pagina di aiuto Rimuovere l'inventario da un centro logistico per creare un ordine di rimozione.
 Le tue offerte sono state rimosse per errore?
 Se ritieni che le tue offerte siano state disattivate per errore e non siano soggette al regolamento sulla sicurezza generale dei prodotti, contatta il Supporto ai partner di vendita . Devi fornire una spiegazione del problema, il nome del marchio e un elenco di ASIN in un file Excel.
 Siamo qui per aiutarti.
 Per scoprire di più sul "Regolamento sulla sicurezza generale dei prodotti" consulta la relativa pagina di aiuto .

subject: Re: 🏆 German quality seal for "Roaxkois Schwimmgurt für Pool"
body_preview:
Hello from Berlin,
I wanted to briefly follow up regarding the Vergleich.org award for your
product “Roaxkois Schwimmgurt für Pool”.
In Germany and the EU, customers usually compare several similar products
before buying. Independent quality seals help them choose, especially when
brands are not yet well known locally.
Brands typically use the Vergleich.org seal on:
  * Amazon.de product pages (images or A+ content)
  * Brand websites and online shops
  * Sales materials for retail and distribution partners
The seal is based on an independent editorial comparison and is only available
for selected, recommended products that are already listed on Vergleich.org.
Would you generally consider using independent German quality seals for
products sold in Germany?
Best regards,
Justin

I wanted to briefly follow up regarding the Vergleich.org award for your
product “Roaxkois Schwimmgurt für Pool”.
In Germany and the EU, customers usually compare several similar products
before buying. Independent quality seals help them choose, especially when
brands are not yet well known locally.
Brands typically use the Vergleich.org seal on:
  * Amazon.de product pages (images or A+ content)
  * Brand websites and online shops
  * Sales materials for retail and distribution partners
The seal is based on an independent editorial comparison and is only available
for selected, recommended products that are already listed on Vergleich.org.
Would you generally consider using independent German quality seals for
products sold in Germany?
Best regards,
Justin

 Take action now to avoid automatic removal of your Fulfilment by Amazon inventory.
 Hello,
 Starting from April 30, 2026, your Fulfilment by Amazon (FBA) inventory that’s been stored over 270 days (aged), stranded over 60 days or unfulfillable over 14 days will be removed from our UK and EU fulfilment centres to free up capacity in our network.
 If you don’t complete one of the following actions by April 30, 2026, we may automatically dispose, donate, liquidate or return your inventory.
- For aged inventory (270+ days): Review your at-risk inventory in FBA inventory , then go to Automated fulfillable settings in Seller Central settings and choose a removal option: Disable, return (processing may take up to 90 days) or dispose (liquidation is available for eligible inventory). If you choose Disable, we will not remove your aged inventory.
- For unfulfillable inventory: Go to Remove unfulfillable inventory and create a removal order.
- For stranded inventory: Go to Fix stranded inventory and create a removal order or select “Edit automatic action settings” to configure your removal preferences. Note: If you’ve created a return order for FBA inventory in last six months, we’ll attempt to return the inventory to the same address that you provided. Removal orders can’t be cancelled once created.
 Amazon is committed to a circular economy in the EU. We donate or recycle everything we can. You can recover value from your inventory when you choose value recovery options.
 For more information, go to Remove inventory from a fulfilment centre .

subject: 提交商品合规文件，以避免商品被移除
body_preview:
96
 提交商品合规文件，以避免商品被移除
 尊敬的 Weihai EU：
您好！
 由于缺少安全数据表，您的商品有被移除的风险。请在 2026-07-27之前提交所需文件，以继续销售这些商品。您可以在此电子邮件的底部找到您的存在风险的商品示例。
 为什么会发生这种情况？
 我们之所以采取此措施，是因为我们在您的目录中发现了需要安全数据表 (SDS) 的危险品。这些文件是法律要求的，提供有关化学品的重要安全信息，包括妥善处理、储存和应急程序。这有助于确保买家、员工及处理这些商品的每一个人的安全。
 为了确定该问题，我们同时采用了自动化技术和专家评审，最终做出了这一决定。
 要了解更多信息，请访问我们 有关化学品销售的要求和常见问题 。
 如何继续销售受影响的商品？
 为避免商品被移除并继续销售这些商品，请为每个受影响的商品上传安全数据表 (SDS)。点击下方的“查看合规要求”按钮，查看所有受影响的商品。
 查看合规性要求
 哪些商品会受到影响？
 原因
 存在风险的销售
 Roaxkois Keramik Bemalen Set - Kreatives Keramik Bastelset mit...
 ASIN: B0G6XCTGJC
 SKU: WH-DE-BZ-1214-01
 HazardousGoods
 2153.13
 如果存在错误？
 如果您确信无需为自己的商品提交文件：

 Hello,
 Starting May 5, 2026, we'll update the way we collect Fulfilment by Amazon (FBA) item package dimensions for products listed in our UK, France, Italy and Spain stores.
 Previously, we used item package measurements taken in our fulfilment centres to calculate FBA fees. With this change, we’ll use the certified dimensions eligible sellers provide to calculate FBA fees for items with an active or new FBA listing in these stores.
 On May 5, you'll receive an email request to verify your existing item package dimensions, or, if needed, provide updated certified dimensions within the next 60 days. Dimensions are certified when taken with a device that complies with the EU Measuring Instruments Directive , for example, a tape measure.
 The certified dimensions that you provide will be used to calculate your fees for local and Pan-European FBA, the European Fulfilment Network, and Remote Fulfilment with FBA. We'll validate your item package dimensions, and, if we find that they're incorrect, we'll use our own certified dimensions.
 To prepare for the verification request, we recommend that you record your certified item package dimensions. For instructions on how to measure your items, go to Understanding item package weight and dimensions .
 For more information, go to FBA item package dimensions certification policy . This change is also reflected in our Changes to program policies , effective May 5.
